Costs were about 1.07M, which is significant at 6.8 switches a year. To beat 21.9% / 22.0%, a plan must cut whipsaw in flat years. Possible routes are slower exits, fewer switches, or staying partly invested, rather than adding defensive sleeves. Also watch the decaying second-half alpha.
